changelog:
- Adds support for annotating tracked keywords with notes and global color-coded tags.
- New commands for creating, editing, deleting, and listing tags.
- New commands to set or clear notes and assign tags to individual tracked keywords.
- `tracked-keywords list` now supports filtering and sorting by notes and tags.
- Documentation and command references updated to reflect the new notes/tags functionality.
- Removed skill-card.md file; added README.md.
